name: VoxyServer-WorldGen Cap
description: Bounds the per-player uplink cost of a Voxy LOD horizon on dedicated servers by reconciling VoxyServer and Voxy WorldGen V2. Cancels WG's per-chunk LOD broadcast and VoxyServer's eager per-section dirty broadcast for fresh-load sections, leaving VoxyServer's batched scan path as the delivery mechanism for new terrain while preserving the dirty path for player block edits. Relaxes the 3-of-4 chunk-footprint initial-load gate so version bumps land immediately when sections are voxelized.
